Name: Futanari Sandy
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]I was browsing Nexus mods and saw that the futanari Emily mod has 92 downloads, thank you so much for that![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]So to celebrate that, I decided to modify Sandy's sprites to make her a futanari too [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. You just need to install SMAPI, then place Content Patcher and the mod in your Stardew Valley mods folder, and that's it. It's not as complicated as it sounds.[/color]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Sandy's default sprites (although there is only one)so that she would have a [b]SNAKE[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.[/color]

Manifest.Name: Futa Sandy
Manifest.Description: Emily's best friend is now a futa too!
